name: dimfort-vscode
description: Dimensional homogeneity checker for Fortran (LSP client).

dimfort.executable.description: Path to the `dimfort` executable. Override if the binary isn't on $PATH (e.g. point at a virtualenv: /path/to/.venv/bin/dimfort).

dimfort.trace.server.description: Trace LSP messages between VSCode and the DimFort server (visible in the Output panel).

dimfort.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inline ghost-text units next to each variable reference. Off by default — redundant beside the DimFort side panel and detailed hover.

dimfort.completion.enabled.description: Suggest known unit names when typing inside `@unit{…}`.

dimfort.codeActions.enabled.description: Offer a quick fix that inserts a `!< @unit{}` annotation on variable declarations that lack one.

dimfort.gotoDefinition.enabled.description: Enable Go to Definition on variables and function/subroutine calls.

enumDescriptions: No hover at all — the side panel is the unit surface.
dimfort.hover.description: Hover verbosity, applied to every hover surface. The side panel is unaffected — it is always detailed and governed only by whether it is open. Cycle with the `DimFort: Cycle Hover Verbosity` command.

enumDescriptions: Defer to the project's `.dimfort.toml` `[scale] enabled` (off if absent).
dimfort.scale.mode.description: Opt-in scale/magnitude checking (S001 multiplicative, S002 affine-offset). `auto` (default) leaves it to the project `.dimfort.toml`; `on`/`off` override it. Cycle with the `DimFort: Cycle Scale Checking` command.

dimfort.maxWorksetSize.description: Maximum number of files included in a single check pipeline. On large workspaces (~2000+ files) the full transitive use-closure can be too deep to compile in memory; when it exceeds this cap, DimFort keeps the active file plus its nearest dependencies in topo order. Restart the language server to apply.

dimfort.externalModules.description: Extra module names treated as external (i.e. not resolved against the workspace; no U007 diagnostic when missing). Extends DimFort's built-in allowlist (Fortran intrinsics, mpi, netcdf, ioipsl, …). Restart the language server to apply.

dimfort.cache.mode.description: Content-hash cache for the workspace check. `read-write` (default): replay and update the cache. `read-only`: replay cached diagnostics but never write. `off`: no caching. On large workspaces (~2000 files), a warm cache drops total check time substantially (a benchmark workspace measured ~33 s cold → ~20 s warm). See [DimFort's cache docs](https://github.com/ArrialVictor/DimFort/blob/main/docs/usage.md#content-hash-cache) for invalidation triggers.

dimfort.cache.dir.description: Optional override for the cache directory. Empty (default) means `.dimfort-cache/` under the first workspace folder.

dimfort.panel.enabled.description: Reveal the DimFort side panel (cursor-following: Expression / Diagnostics / Interactions / Actions / Scope) on activation. On by default; set to false to keep it closed and open it manually from the DimFort activity-bar icon.

dimfort.panel.debounceMs.description: Debounce (milliseconds) for the side panel's cursor-follow refresh.

enumDescriptions: Source order — the line each declaration sits on (default).
Errors first, then unannotated, then annotated; ties broken by line.
dimfort.panel.scopeSortMode.description: Sort order for the side panel's Scope section. Override per session via the right-click menu on a `Scope:` header.

enumDescriptions: Source order — the line of the `use` statement in the current file (default).
Lower-cased name compare within each module group.
Unannotated first, then annotated; ties broken by name.
dimfort.panel.importsSortMode.description: Sort order within each module group of the side panel's Imports section. Override per session via the right-click menu on the `from <module>` header.

enumDescriptions: Show only the unit as it appears in source (e.g. `hPa`) — thinnest panel.
Show only the canonical base-SI form (e.g. `100×kg/m/s²`).
Show both, with the canonical column populated only when it differs from input (legacy display).
dimfort.panel.unitDisplayMode.description: Which unit column(s) the Scope and Imports views render. Toggle via the title-bar icon on either view.

enumDescriptions: One dot per line in the left margin (gutter), in the four tiers: green / yellow / red / blue.
Low-alpha background tint behind each in-scope line, in the same four tiers.
dimfort.coverage.mode.description: Per-line coverage visualisation: paints a four-tier projection of the checker's status onto the editor. `gutter` and `background` are mutually-exclusive visual encodings of the same data; pick the visual weight you prefer. Cycle with the `DimFort: Cycle Coverage Visualisation` command.

dimfort.coverage.debounceMs.description: Debounce (milliseconds) for the coverage layer's refresh after a document change.
